title: Reframe quickstart hero flow illustration and screen treatments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Refresh the Quickstart landing experience with a cohesive visual language: a new hero illustration that clarifies value props, three step diagrams that show developer onboarding flow, and updated in-product screenshots with annotated callouts for release marketing and docs.
background: Recent user feedback and analytics show dropoff on the Quickstart landing page. Current assets are inconsistent across marketing, docs, and console. This ticket consolidates visual direction, produces production-ready hero art, step diagrams, and final screenshots optimized for multiple breakpoints.
goals: Increase quickstart completion rate by clarifying first 3 developer actions
Ship cohesive hero and step diagrams that work in marketing, docs, and console templates
Provide annotated in-product screenshots aligned with runtime-1.18 and console-2026.03 releases
deliverables: Primary hero illustration (SVG + 3 responsive export sizes)
Three-step flow diagram with alternate text labels (light & dark)
Set of 6 annotated screenshots for docs and marketing (desktop + mobile variants)
Design tokens and spacing guidance for engineers
Figma file with componentized hero and diagram elements
acceptance_criteria: Hero conveys value props: fast onboarding, predictable performance, developer-first API
Diagrams map directly to quickstart steps in docs and match copy in PRD
Screenshots are up-to-date with runtime-1.18 UI and annotated with callouts that match console copy
Assets exported at required sizes and formats, named per asset spec, and uploaded to Drive
Accessibility check: all diagrams have alt text drafts and contrast meets AA
tasks: Audit existing quickstart visuals and collect URLs (marketing, docs, console)
Sketch 3 hero concepts and review with PM and engineering
Iterate chosen hero in Figma and produce SVG master
Design step diagram system with modular components
Capture fresh screenshots from dev/staging console (coordinate with ENG)
Create annotated callouts and export assets in required breakpoints
Prepare handoff package and upload to Drive; create GH PR linking images to docs
Schedule design review and accessibility signoff
design_review_notes: PM asked for less literal device imagery and stronger emphasis on latency/cost tradeoffs. Prefer illustration direction A (abstract pipeline) over B (single-device). Keep brand palette but introduce a secondary accent for callouts.
assets_needed: Figma master file (new page: Quickstart Refresh)
Diagrams in both light and dark theme variants
visual_direction: Clean, developer-focused illustration language that abstracts infrastructure concepts into approachable shapes. Prefer flat layers, subtle gradients for depth, and motion-friendly layouts for future micro-animations.
accessibility_requirements: Provide alt text for every diagram and hero (draft copy included)
Ensure color contrast AA for primary callouts
Verify text is selectable in exported SVGs where applicable
